issues.explanation: Invalid PHP: trait-style use inside class and Gate::policy calls nested inside Password::defaults closure so policies never register and app cannot boot.
Dashboard mounts any entity by slug with no membership check or authorize call, so non-members can view it instead of getting 403.
Switcher uses one outer form whose action references $entity before the foreach, instead of one POST form per entity to entity.pick.
Factories have no namespace Database\Factories so they are not discovered, Entity slug is not unique, and employee() state is missing.
Role checks compare cast UserRole enum to strings, so Entity update/delete/manageSettings and Membership assignRole always deny and owner delete check never matches.
Membership delete only blocks owner self-removal and, due to enum mismatch, allows owner self-removal while not blocking deletion of any owner membership.
CreateEntity has no retry on unique slug violation at insert time, so concurrent collisions throw instead of generating the next slug.
CurrentEntity middleware never resolves tenant context into the request and never checks the route entity, and no current_entity alias is registered.
Home route uses findOrFail on possibly-null session value instead of implementing 0/1/many dispatch with onboarding and switcher redirects.
Navbar link to entity.switcher for users with more than one membership is absent from the diff.
owner_seq generated column is not declared stored, violating the portability requirement for the single-owner constraint.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, including required unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Domain write creates Entity and membership directly in Livewire via DB::transaction instead of an app/Actions class.
Livewire validation uses inline validate array instead of the project #[Validate] attribute pattern.
Middleware imports six unused facades and provider has mis-indented boot with use inside class.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:77 `$this->validate([...])` without #[Validate]; CreateEntity.php:79 DB::transaction in component instead of app/Actions/*; zero tests; database/factories/EntityFactory.php:1 missing namespace

readability.evidence: app/Http/Middleware/CurrentEntity.php:12 six unused imports; app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:27 `use` inside class with mis-indented boot; resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:4 `$entity` used before foreach; app/Models/User.php:28 trailing whitespace

requirements.evidence: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:27 `use Illuminate\Auth\Gate;` inside class plus Gate::policy inside Password::defaults; app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:7 no authorize/403; resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:4 action uses out-of-scope $entity; factories lack namespace, unique slug, employee(); app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:79 no retry; navbar absent

scope.evidence: all hunks serve entities/memberships/onboarding/switcher/dashboard; docs/database-schema.md:31-89 required update; no members/settings/invitations/billing changes

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:7 `public Entity $entity` trusted without authorize; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:392 `in_array($membership->role, ['owner','admin'])` enum vs string; app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:347 `$membership->role === 'owner'` never true

simplicity.evidence: lean change with no speculative layers; negatives: app/Http/Middleware/CurrentEntity.php:12-18 unused facades; lang/en/ui.php:601-606 duplicate create_entity_*/onboarding_* keys

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ files; no happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call, or tamper tests

review.summary: Adds entities, memberships, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher and dashboard, but the app provider is syntactically broken, dashboard lacks authorization, policies compare enums to strings, factories and switcher forms are broken, and no tests ship, so the change must be rejected pending rework.
